Loss report: gitlab -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (hidden) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/empty/step/script step.script (the job has no steps; a no-op step keeps the workflow valid)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.env: copied into the environment of every step (a step variable of the same name wins)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/empty job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/empty step.script: no-op step (Woodpecker needs a step; the job has no step to run, so a no-op step stands in)
